chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Haytham ibn Waqid, who said:
I heard Al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام saying:

Whoever Allah, Mighty and Majestic, brings out from the humiliation of acts of disobedience to the honor of taqwa, Allah enriches him without wealth, honors him without a tribe, and gives him companionship without a companion. Whoever fears Allah, Mighty and Majestic, Allah will make everything fear him; and whoever does not fear Allah, Mighty and Majestic, Allah will make him fear everything. Whoever is content from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with a little provision, Allah will be content from him with a little deed. Whoever is not ashamed to seek livelihood, his burden becomes light and He grants ease to his family. And whoever renounces the world, Allah will firmly place wisdom in his heart, make his tongue speak by it, make him see the faults of the world, its sickness and its cure, and bring him forth from the world safely to the Abode of Peace.

key_terms.الْحِكْمَةَ: wisdom firmly established by Allah in the heart
key_terms.الْيَسِيرِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ: a small share of provision apportioned by Allah
key_terms.دَارِ السَّلَامِ: the Abode of Peace, i.e. the final abode of safety
key_terms.ذُلِّ الْمَعَاصِي: the abasement and humiliation caused by acts of disobedience
key_terms.طَلَبِ الْمَعَاشِ: seeking one’s livelihood and means of living
key_terms.عِزِّ التَّقْوَى: the honor and dignity that come through taqwa

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the effects of taqwa, contentment, and renouncing the world?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that taqwa transforms a person from the abasement of sin into true dignity, independence, and inner security granted by Allah. It also links fear of Allah, contentment with provision, lawful striving for livelihood, and renunciation of dunya with wisdom, ease, and ultimate safety in the hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, brings out from the humiliation of sins to the honor of piety, Allah (swt) enriches him without wealth, honors him without a tribe, and comforts him without a companion.
Whoever fears Allah (swt), Allah (swt) will make everything fear him, and whoever does not fear Allah (swt), Allah (swt) will make him fear everything.
Whoever is content with the little provision Allah (swt) gives him, Allah (swt) will be pleased with his little deeds.
Whoever is not ashamed to seek his livelihood, his burdens will be lightened, and his family will be blessed.
And whoever renounces the world, Allah (swt) will instill wisdom in his heart, make it flow from his tongue, show him the flaws of the world - its sickness and its cure - and will take him safely from this world to the abode of peace."
